title: POV: people can create anything in the world
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
I built an online game where players can build everything in the world using prompts (and AI does the rest)

What do you think of this? Would love to hear your feedback :D

You can try it here: [https://theflairgame.com/](https://theflairgame.com/)

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: Looks promising but lacking. I don’t like the art style but understand why. What is the fun and the challenge? I mean say any thing and it get generated as pixels is fun 5-10 times and then what?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Really good question! So the fun comes from making this to an online open world that changes everyday. So you don’t only see what you create, the whole world develops it every second. There Are lots of NPCs and Jobs that give the whole world a meaning and Story. It’s basically like gta online but with more depth and fully emergent

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: Sounds intresting but I don’t like the art. But it’s just me. :) best of luck!

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: I understand! Thanks for the feedback!
